## 主张 Claim

对每个字母表与汲取律：在每一位接合配准所读之物的复制产生某词，当且仅当每一位读出该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其汲取，其产物只增长；对每个过程，每步延长输出当且仅当每段进程延长输出，每个非门控步保持的量沿每段非门控进程保持。配准机中，对每个状态，与词长相同数目的复制步把产物延长为该词，当且仅当每一位经实际连接读出其记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其汲取；完整稳定配准恢复既有复制是其实例；每段进程使产物的边为其记号上的路径，所以完整配准复制模板（含边）当且仅当模板的边是该路径。缺接、错位与重接通过改变各位所读而改变后继；只有复制步改变产物，故连接变化不改写产物，每个允许的有限历史保留已成前缀及连接件、材料与支持的总量。消耗连接件和支持形成的配准接入材料复制。 / For every alphabet and law of draws: a copy attaching at each site what a registration reads there produces a word exactly when every site reads the word's token, the pool supplies the word and the support covers what it draws, and its product only grows; for every process an output is extended along every course exactly when every step extends it, and a quantity kept by every ungated step is kept along every ungated course. In the registration machine, for every state, as many copy moves as a word has tokens extend the product by that word exactly when each site reads its token through the actual contacts, the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; complete stable registration recovering prior copying is the instance; every course keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens, so complete registration copies the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path. Loss, displacement and rebinding change the successor by changing what sites read; only copy moves change the product, so contact changes never rewrite it, and every admitted finite history keeps its built prefix and its totals of connectors, material and support. Connector- and support-consuming registration enters material copying.

Canonical source: [CopyingRegistration.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/CopyingRegistration.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 索引位置与选择性对接、可靠取值、局部接合成本及事件发生给定；没有切除或替换已成产物的操作。 / Indexed sites, selective docking, reliable transduction, local attachment costs and event occurrence are supplied; there is no excision or replacement of built material.
- 一般继承组合要求完整值配准、模板与前缀／剩余序列一致，且保留原定理的路径及材料／支持前提（非空前提不需要）。 / The general inheritance composition requires complete value registration and template/prefix/suffix consistency, retaining the prior path and material/support premises (the nonempty premise is not needed).

角色由共同活动中的对接、取值、移入与保留关系分化；配准为实际位置对，并非成功标签。局部辨别规律仍在等索引对接条件中给定。 / Roles differentiate through docking, reading, transfers and retention in common activity; registration consists of actual position pairs, not a success flag. Local discrimination remains supplied by the equal-index docking guard.

33项新定理声明／54项新审计，484项实际闭包审计中430项继承分列；原始论文作为既有比较重读，无新经验复算。一般律已由检查器回执绑定。 / 33 new theorem declarations / 54 new audits, with 430 inherited declarations separate in 484 actual-closure audits. 未导出索引识别／取值规律、损伤率、纠错启动、切除机制、自供或种群选择；同等接触机制的强对手具有相同解释能力。 / Indexed recognition/transduction, damage rates, repair initiation, excision, autonomous provision and population selection are not derived; a strong rival retaining the same contact mechanism has the same explanatory capacity.

- 缺接可在有材料和支持时停滞；连接错位未必改值，重接不追改旧产物，连接数和全部复制状态相同仍可产出不同序列。 / Missing contacts stall despite stock/support; displacement need not change the value, rebinding does not rewrite old output, and matched contact counts/full copying state can produce different sequences.
